title: MNI Open iEEG Atlas: normal intracranial EEG in wakefulness and sleep (processed 200 Hz atlas clips)
description: Processed part of the MNI Open iEEG Atlas, providing artifact-free intracranial EEG (stereo-EEG and subdural strips/grids) from 106 patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy. Channels recording normal activity are included. The data comprise one minute per vigilance state (wakefulness, N2, N3, REM) plus up to 10 minutes of N2 and N3 sleep, resampled to 200 Hz and stored as bipolar derivations with MNI-space electrode coordinates. The dataset serves as a normative reference for intracranial brain activity across cortical regions and sleep stages.
methods_description: Source authors low-pass filtered at 80 Hz and resampled to 200 Hz, reduced power-line interference with an adaptive filter, visually rejected artifacts, removed per-segment means, and concatenated artifact-free segments with zero buffers. The data were repacked losslessly into BrainVision float32 format without further filtering or re-referencing. Recordings are bipolar derivations from three epilepsy centres.
